verdict.rationale: Kit has no documented in-product AI insights or suggestions. Its first-party remote Kit MCP server exposes account data (subscribers, broadcasts, tags, segments) to external MCP-compatible AI clients, and the API returns broadcast and link-click stats, so a user can get AI analysis only by bringing their own AI client. Missing for 10: native in-product AI-generated insights or recommendations, any evidence of AI analysis of engagement or performance data, hands-on or independent corroboration.
